definitions.aggregation: Stage pose/contact main group: 5 complete frame-zero cycles. Per-joint global peaks include all recorded samples and the censored tail. Randomized episodes cover different phase ranges.
definitions.body_weight: Recorded randomized total mass *9.81, per case.
definitions.force: Net normal contact force averaged over each 5ms physics step; excludes friction. Thigh/shank force removes robot self contact.
definitions.hip_symmetry: Both URDF hip axes are -X (confirmed in composed USD). Mirror symmetry uses q_left + q_right; tracking residual subtracts the reference sum.
definitions.landing_event: Longest recorded >=50ms interval with all four foot/wheel plus four thigh/shank forces below 1N in 1.20-1.80s, followed by measured support; analyze observed first touchdown and 1.45-2.10s window.
definitions.phase_meaning: Reporting windows, not acceptance gates. Pose/reference tracking uses commanded reference frame/fps; physics records add completed 5ms substeps.
definitions.torque: PD applied drive torque; excludes passive joint reaction/contact-impact torque.
definitions.unloaded_wheel: net normal force magnitude <1 N; this proves loss of measured support, not positive geometric separation or lift height
definitions.velocity_limits: Saved actuator velocity_limit values are comparison references. Simulator constraint solutions can briefly exceed a nominal velocity limit; this is measured joint speed, not target speed.

limitations: One seed and finite phase coverage; not convergence or hardware readiness.
Wheel contact gaps and PhysX cooked collision geometry were not recorded. Original USD/STL geometry reconstruction does not measure the actual cooked-shape separation.
Normal force peaks are 5ms averages, not instantaneous impact-force peaks.
Passive load-bearing joint reaction torque and thermal/RMS motor acceptance ratings were not recorded.
question: Preparation wheel support, base tilt, hip symmetry, full-motion joint drive effort/speed, and landing normal contact loads
